dialogues.jp:
並木道の桜の幹に、スーツ姿の男性が寄りかかっ
ていた。
dialogues.en: A well-dressed man was leaning on a tree at Sakura Avenue.
dialogues.text: A well-dressed man was leaning on a tree at Sakura Avenue.

dialogues.jp:
「人待ち顔？　……しかし、スーツなんか着て
　る人が、学校に何の用だ……？」
dialogues.en:
"Expecting something? ...But what would someone in a
business suit want with a school...?"
dialogues.text:
"Expecting something? ...But what would someone in a
business suit want with a school...?"

dialogues.jp:
少し気になった俺は、桜の影に隠れて様子をう
かがう。
dialogues.en:
My curiosity piqued, I took shelter under a nearby tree as
well and waited.
dialogues.text:
My curiosity piqued, I took shelter under a nearby tree as
well and waited.

dialogues.jp:
待つ事数分。遂に、スーツと接触した人が居た
が、それは、暦先生だった。
dialogues.en:
After awhile, a person went up to meet the suited man. It
was Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text:
After awhile, a person went up to meet the suited man. It
was Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.jp: 「暦先生……か。ってことは、もしや、恋人？」

声は聞こえないが、暦先生がスーツに対して何
か怒っているようだ。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't hear them from here, but I could tell from their
expressions that Koyomi was angry for some reason.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't hear them from here, but I could tell from their
expressions that Koyomi was angry for some reason.

dialogues.jp:
そうして、怒りながら、スーツの手を引き、さっ
さと学園から離れようとする。
dialogues.en: Shen then dragged the man out of the school campus.
dialogues.text: Shen then dragged the man out of the school campus.

dialogues.jp:
「……なるほど、たぶん、見られたくないんだ
　な。学園の連中には」
dialogues.en:
"...I see. She probably didn't want the rest of the school
to see him."
dialogues.text:
"...I see. She probably didn't want the rest of the school
to see him."

dialogues.jp:
「けど、二人の関係は何なんだろう？　やっぱ、
　恋人かな……」
dialogues.en:
"But what do those two have to do with each other? Maybe
they really are lovers..."
dialogues.text:
"But what do those two have to do with each other? Maybe
they really are lovers..."

dialogues.jp: 少しだけ気になったりする。
dialogues.en: It made me wonder for a bit.
dialogues.text: It made me wonder for a bit.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、首を傾げながら、桜の中から並木道へ戻っ
たのだった。
dialogues.en: Shaking my head a few times, I continued down Sakura Avenue.
dialogues.text: Shaking my head a few times, I continued down Sakura Avenue.

dialogues.jp:
放課後の桜並木に、場にそぐわないスーツ姿の
男がいた。
dialogues.en:
After school, standing under a sakura tree, was a man in a
business suit, looking very out of place.
dialogues.text:
After school, standing under a sakura tree, was a man in a
business suit, looking very out of place.

dialogues.jp:
いったい何者だ？　と思ったら、やってきたの
は暦先生だった。
dialogues.en:
Just who was that? As I was thinking, Koyomi-sensei
appeared.
dialogues.text:
Just who was that? As I was thinking, Koyomi-sensei
appeared.

dialogues.jp:
もしや、暦先生の恋人かっ！？　やっぱ学園の
人間には、見られたくないんだろうな。
dialogues.en:
Maybe it's Koyomi-sensei's boyfriend!? If that's the case,
she definitely wouldn't want anybody in school to see him.
dialogues.text:
Maybe it's Koyomi-sensei's boyfriend!? If that's the case,
she definitely wouldn't want anybody in school to see him.
